summary: SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT_v1 passes QA with 8 issues (0 critical, 2 major, 6 minor) and 0 blockers. All 5 pipeline files reviewed (spec.json pending assembly). Cross-file threading validated: 58 TSK_CABT_* IDs in sop_modules match 58 rates in production. 4 paintable items: ITM_CABINET_DOOR (EA), ITM_CABINET_DRAWER (EA), ITM_CABINET_FRAME (SF), ITM_CABINET_INTERIOR (SF conditional). Separate spray/brush finish tasks (7 in MOD_CABT_FINISH_COAT). Combined prime+paint with primer conditional on substrate_state. 7 substrate-driven primer systems (6 existing + 1 proposed SYS_PRIMER_BONDING) + 3 QT-driven finish systems, all reusing existing SYS_FF_* IDs. 9 protection zones across 7+6 setup/teardown tasks properly paired. MDF edge seal protocol correctly sequenced (MOD_CABT_PREP before MOD_CABT_PRIME). Door style modifier correctly scoped to door/drawer tasks only. 5-7 day cure period documented. Modifier stacking max 3.29x — well under 4.0x flag. Two major issues: (1) task_count_summary claims 61 tasks but actual count is 58, (2) skill_level key missing from all SOP tasks. 6 minor issues: PS key UOM inconsistencies in backsplash/wall masking tasks, research primer ID mapping note, PROTECT_CEILING zone mismatch, production rates are research-based assumptions, and binary/qt_scaled classification counts off. Human Feedback Gate has NOT occurred — expected for v0.1.0 draft.

modifier_stacking_threshold.details: modifier_stacking_validation.maximum_theoretical: QT5 + raised_panel + extra_tall + very_complex = 1.5 * 1.30 * 1.30 * 1.30 = 3.29x (frame tasks). Note: raised_panel does not normally apply to frame tasks, so realistic max for frames = 2.54x, realistic max for doors = 1.95x. All well under 4.0x flag threshold. flag_threshold documented as 4.0.

cabinet_vs_builtin_comparison.details: BLTN door spray rate ~10 EA/hr. CABT door spray finish rate 11 EA/hr — within expected range (cabinet doors similar size to built-in doors). BLTN door brush rate not directly comparable but CABT 6 EA/hr brush is ~55% of spray — reasonable spray-to-brush ratio. BLTN hardware removal ~30-45 pieces/hr vs CABT 35 EA/hr — consistent. BLTN door removal ~15-20/hr vs CABT 18 EA/hr — consistent. No rates more than 2x different from BLTN precedent without explanation.

spray_vs_brush_rates.details: Frame spray finish 200 SF/hr vs brush 105 SF/hr — spray ~1.9x faster. Door spray finish 11 EA/hr vs brush 6 EA/hr — spray ~1.83x faster. Drawer spray 15 EA/hr vs brush 8 EA/hr — spray ~1.88x faster. Frame prime spray 225 SF/hr vs brush 115 SF/hr — spray ~1.96x faster. All spray rates exceed brush rates as expected. Ratios consistent with 1.4x brush time modifier documented in research.

drawer_vs_door_ratio.details: Drawer-to-door ratios: spray finish 15/11=0.73x faster (matching 0.7x research target). Brush finish 8/6=0.75x faster. Sand doors 18/24(drawers)=0.75x (drawers faster). Fill drawers 20/15(doors)=0.75x (drawers faster). Consistent 0.7-0.75x ratio throughout — matches research.json 0.7x specification.

interior_rates.details: Interior prime 175 SF/hr, finish 150 SF/hr. Research range: prime 150-200, finish 130-170. Both within documented ranges. Interior rates slower than frame rates (225/200 spray) due to awkward enclosed access — reasonable.

issues.description: skill_level key is MISSING from all 58 tasks in sop_modules.json. Per structural_keys.json task_structure.required_keys, skill_level is a required task key. The BLTN sibling spec includes skill_level on all 35 tasks. This is a structural compliance gap.
issues.suggested_fix: Add skill_level to each task: 'helper' for protection setup/teardown and cleaning tasks, 'journeyman' for prep/prime/finish application tasks, 'lead' for inspection and quality-critical tasks (FINAL_INSPECT, TOUCHUP, edge seal). Follow BLTN precedent for assignment pattern.

issues.description: TSK_CABT_PROTECT_CEILING uses zone 'fixture_covers' but this is a ceiling masking task. The resolution.json does not list a dedicated ceiling spray protection zone — fixture_covers is the closest existing zone but semantically represents light/outlet fixtures, not ceiling plastic sheeting. PROTECT_PLUMBING and PROTECT_ELECTRICAL also share fixture_covers zone, which is correct for those tasks. The ceiling task would more properly use a ceiling-specific zone or a spray masking zone.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable for v0.1.0 — fixture_covers is a reasonable zone assignment. During spec.json assembly, consider whether a dedicated spray_masking or ceiling_spray zone is needed. Non-blocking.

issues.description: TSK_CABT_PROTECT_BACKSPLASH has unit_of_measure=LF and paintscope_key=PS_PROTECT_SF.ASSET.TILE_BACKSPLASH. The PS_ key name contains 'SF' but the actual measurement is in LF. Resolution.json notes this tension: 'PS_ key from Reference is SF-based; downstream may need to reconcile or create a LF variant.' The task correctly uses LF as the operational UOM, but the PS_ key prefix suggests SF.
issues.suggested_fix: Non-blocking for v0.1.0. During registry update, consider renaming to PS_PROTECT_LF.ASSET.TILE_BACKSPLASH for consistency, or document that the PS_ category prefix does not always match the UOM.

issues.description: TSK_CABT_PROTECT_WALL has unit_of_measure=SF and paintscope_key=PS_PROTECT_LF.WALL_ADJACENT_CABINET. The PS_ key name contains 'LF' but the actual measurement is in SF (wall masking area). Resolution.json notes: 'PS_ key exists in Protection_Zones_Reference (wall_adjacent_cabinet zone) but uses LF in reference. Research uses SF for wall masking area.' The task and production.json correctly use SF rates.
issues.suggested_fix: Non-blocking for v0.1.0. During registry update, consider creating PS_PROTECT_SF.WALL_ADJACENT_CABINET for SF-based measurement, or document the PS_ naming convention exception.

issues.description: SYS_PRIMER_BONDING is a PROPOSED new system ID. Resolution.json correctly flags it in registry_additions_proposed. It is not yet in id_registry.json. This is expected for a new spec but must be registered before deployment.
issues.suggested_fix: Register SYS_PRIMER_BONDING in id_registry.json during assembly step. Non-blocking for v0.1.0 draft.

issues.description: All production rates are research-based estimates with doctrine gaps flagged (assumptions A-001 through A-010). No canonical doctrine provides per-door, per-drawer, or per-frame-SF cabinet painting rates. Rates are calibrated from research ranges and cross-referenced against BLTN precedent. Door spray finish 11 EA/hr (research: 10-12) and frame spray 200 SF/hr (research: 180-220) are reasonable midpoint selections.
issues.suggested_fix: Flag for field validation. Rate ranges provided throughout. All rates within research-documented ranges. App allows per-task rate adjustment.

issues.description: Prime tasks (TSK_CABT_PRIME_FRAMES, PRIME_DOORS, PRIME_DRAWERS, PRIME_INTERIOR) are classified as 'binary' but have rates_by_method in production.json (spray/brush variants). Binary classification is correct per doctrine — primer application rate does not vary by quality tier. The rates_by_method structure on binary tasks is non-standard (BLTN used rates_by_substrate_state for binary), but the content is valid: primer rate depends on method, not QT.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable. rates_by_method on binary tasks is a valid pattern for method-dependent rates that are NOT QT-driven. Document this pattern for future specs.

Material systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5). Sheen/QT gates enforced. key_characteristics: 4 paintable items: ITM_CABINET_DOOR (EA), ITM_CABINET_DRAWER (EA), ITM_CABINET_FRAME (SF), ITM_CABINET_INTERIOR (SF conditional on scope=full_with_interior).
58 tasks total (31 binary, 27 qt_scaled) across 7 modules — complex spec reflecting kitchen/bath cabinet painting with 9 protection zones.
Separate spray/brush finish tasks (7 tasks in MOD_CABT_FINISH_COAT) with method-specific rates. Spray 1.8-2.0x faster than brush throughout.
Door/drawer removal workflow: remove in SETUP, paint flat on sawhorses in FINISH_COAT, reinstall in CLEANUP after 5-7 day cure. Two separate mobilizations.

5 modifiers: door_style (slab/shaker/raised_panel/glass_frame), quality_tier (QT3-QT5), height (8-12ft), kitchen_complexity (simple-very_complex), masking_scope (informational only — handled by task activation).
Drawer-to-door time ratio consistently 0.7x across all task types — matches research specification.
Cabinet interiors always QT3 regardless of exterior tier (AWI semi-exposed standard), spray-only.
7 primer systems (6 existing + 1 proposed SYS_PRIMER_BONDING) + 3 finish systems (all reused SYS_FF_*). REUSE OVER CREATION principle followed for finish systems.
4 round configurations cover all substrate_state x quality_tier x method combinations.
9 protection zones — most of any spec — reflecting enclosed kitchen environment with high-value adjacent surfaces (countertops, backsplash, appliances).
review_notes: Cabinet painting spec successfully builds on the BLTN precedent for door removal/flat painting/cure/reinstall workflow while adding cabinet-specific complexity: 4 distinct item types (door, drawer, frame, interior), 9 protection zones, kitchen_complexity modifier, and countertop/backsplash protection. The dual spray/brush task architecture (7 finish coat tasks) is more sophisticated than BLTN's 4 finish tasks and correctly captures the rate differential. Drawer-to-door 0.7x ratio is consistently maintained. Interior QT3 override is properly enforced. MDF edge seal sequencing is correct. Two major issues require fix before deployment: (1) add skill_level to all 58 SOP tasks, (2) correct task_count_summary from 61 to 58. The 6 minor issues are naming tensions, documentation items, and field validation flags — all acceptable for v0.1.0 draft.
